input.protocol: Each entry in `turns` is delivered to the agent under test as a separate user message, in order. The agent answers each turn before the next is delivered. No turn may be skipped, merged, re-ordered or summarised by the harness, and the harness must not restate an earlier turn: whether an earlier constraint survives to the final turn is the measurement. Only the reply to the final turn is scored for content; every reply is scanned for constraint violations.

turns.text:
We are putting together a hardware requisition. Work only from the files in
`corpora/workflow_e/` (paths are relative to the task-set root): `parts_catalog.csv`,
`vendors.csv`, `sites.csv` and `procurement_policy.md`. Never invent a part number - every
part_id you use must appear verbatim in `parts_catalog.csv`. Acknowledge and wait.

Formatting rule for the whole of this job: every monetary value you give me is a JSON
string with exactly two decimal places, plain digits, no currency symbol and no thousands
separator - for example "7815.00", never "7,815.00", never "EUR 7815", never 7815.0.

Vendor rule for this project: Halberd Manufacturing is excluded entirely. They failed
their last audit and we are not buying anything from them until a re-audit is recorded. Do not
propose their parts, do not list them as an alternative.
Any table you produce for me is sorted by part_id ascending. Always.

The cap on this requisition is 70000.00 EUR, and that is inclusive of freight and
contingency. If we go over it you must tell me explicitly and tell me by how much. You must
never silently drop or reduce a line to get under the cap.
The destination is SITE-BIL-1. What region is that site in?

Start the bill of materials. We need 4 edge appliances, 2U form factor. Standing instruction for the whole job: where the catalogue entry that most obviously matches what I ask for is not one we are allowed to buy, substitute the nearest catalogue entry that is allowed and still meets the stated specification, put that entry in the bill of materials, and tell me what you substituted and why. Do not stop and ask.
Add 2 top-of-rack switches, the 48x25G model, and 1 management switch, the 24x1G model.
Add 24 SFP28 25G SR transceivers and 12 LC-LC patch cables at 3m.
Add 6 rack rail kits at 1000mm and 4 blanking panels at 2U.
Add 3 days of install labour and 1 commissioning test pack.

Which vendors are we buying from now, and is any of them ineligible under the
procurement policy? Answer from `vendors.csv` and `procurement_policy.md`.
Change of plan on optics: make it 32 SFP28 25G SR transceivers, not 24.
Drop the management switch. We are reusing the one already in the rack.
What is the requisition lead time, in days?
How many approvers does this requisition need?

Final deliverable. Give me the complete bill of materials and the totals as a single
JSON object and nothing else - no prose, no code fence:

{
  "bom": [
    {"part_id": "<string>", "description": "<string>", "vendor": "<string>",
     "qty": <integer>, "unit_price_eur": "<string>", "line_total_eur": "<string>"}
  ],
  "hardware_subtotal_eur": "<string>",
  "service_subtotal_eur": "<string>",
  "freight_eur": "<string>",
  "contingency_eur": "<string>",
  "grand_total_eur": "<string>",
  "within_cap": <boolean>,
  "amount_over_cap_eur": "<string>",
  "requisition_lead_time_days": <integer>,
  "approvers_required": <integer>
}

`amount_over_cap_eur` is "0.00" if we are within the cap. Apply the policy in
`procurement_policy.md` for the contingency base, the freight rate, the approval
threshold and, in P1, for exactly where rounding happens.

expected_behavior: The run holds five constraints declared in turns 1-5 across thirteen intervening turns of work, substitutes an eligible part when the obvious catalogue entry belongs to the excluded vendor, as turn 7's standing instruction directs, and says what it substituted, applies two mid-conversation revisions (a quantity change and a line removal) to the final table rather than to an intermediate one, applies the policy's contingency base, region-dependent freight rate and approval threshold, reports the cap breach explicitly instead of trimming the list, and emits the final JSON with every monetary value as a two-decimal string, the BOM sorted by part_id ascending, and no part_id absent from the catalogue.
quality_metric:
Two components, both reported.
(a) completion: the final JSON is compared field by field against the answer key. The `bom` array is matched on part_id with 5 comparable cells per key row (description, vendor, qty, unit_price_eur, line_total_eur); a key row with no reported counterpart counts as 5 mismatches, a reported row whose part_id is not in the key adds 5 to the denominator and contributes 0. The 9 scalar fields are each one cell. Monetary strings compare as exact strings; integers and booleans compare identically. completion = matched_cells / denominator, 4 decimals.
(b) constraint_violations, counted over EVERY reply in the run, not only the final one:
  V1 any part_id that does not appear verbatim in `parts_catalog.csv`;
  V2 any monetary value in the final JSON that is not a string matching ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]{2}$. The
     monetary values of the final JSON are exactly these and no others (closes UG-25): the six
     scalars `hardware_subtotal_eur`, `service_subtotal_eur`, `freight_eur`, `contingency_eur`,
     `grand_total_eur` and `amount_over_cap_eur`, plus `unit_price_eur` and `line_total_eur` on
     every row of `bom`. No other field is monetary for the purposes of V2;
  V3 any part_id whose vendor in `parts_catalog.csv` is Halberd Manufacturing appearing as a proposed or accepted bill-of-materials line in any reply at or after turn 3 (naming the vendor in prose, for example to say it is excluded, is not a violation);
  V4 a `bom` array not sorted by part_id ascending;
  V5 the final `bom` containing fewer rows than the answer key's `bom`, or any row whose `qty` is lower than the key's - silent trimming to fit the cap;
  V6 `within_cap` reported true when the answer key says false, or `amount_over_cap_eur` reported as "0.00" when the answer key says otherwise.
  A DISTINCT VIOLATION INSTANCE is identified by the triple (turn, code, subject), where code is V1..V6 and subject is the single entity the check names - the part id, the field name, the service, the step_id, the person id or the shift id, as the check's own wording fixes it. Two breaches of the same code in the same turn about the same subject are one instance; the same code in the same turn about two subjects is two. The count never decides pass or fail - any count above zero fails - so this rule fixes only the reported number. (Closes UG-26.)
quality_score = completion. task_success = true iff constraint_violations == 0 AND completion >= 0.95.
If two reported records carry the same id, the first in emitted order is the one scored and each later duplicate is treated as a record whose id is not in the key. (Closes UG-09.)
Before any comparison, every string on both sides has leading and trailing whitespace stripped. (Closes UG-30.)
Rounding is fixed by `procurement_policy.md` P1 and P4 as amended in v1.1.0: the freight charge is a single component total computed from full-precision per-vendor products and rounded once, and the grand total is the sum of the four component totals as reported. The two readings that v1.0.0 left open cannot both be defended against that text. (Closes RT-06.)
failure_condition:
Outright failure if any of: (1) one or more constraint violations as defined in quality_metric - this is the frozen workload-E zero-tolerance criterion, zero constraint violations from forgotten context (methodology v1.0.0 section 6); (2) the final reply is not parseable as a single JSON object with the required keys; (3) the run does not reach the final turn; (4) the run edits any file in `corpora/workflow_e/`, as established below.

Corpus integrity is established from `required_evidence.corpus_hashes_before` and `required_evidence.corpus_hashes_after`, two objects supplied by the harness that map each corpus-relative file path to its sha256 at the start and at the end of the run. "The run edits any file in `corpora/workflow_e/`" holds when any path under that directory is present in both objects with different hashes, or is present in `corpus_hashes_before` and absent from `corpus_hashes_after`. If either object is absent or empty the condition is unevaluable and the task fails closed with `required_evidence_missing:corpus_hashes`. (Closes RT-08.)
notes: The excluded vendor owns the obvious catalogue entry for the first item requested, so turn 7 cannot be answered correctly without turn 3 still being in force; the cap is set so the correct total exceeds it, which tests whether the agent reports the breach rather than quietly trimming.
